element.content: Welcome to Naticord! We'll get your appearance settings setup, how you'd like to client to function and various other things!

Naticord is based off of Windows Forms and DirectUI, allowing for neat animations and aesthetically pleasing elements to be done natively. DirectUI is a markup language by Microsoft, similar to the likes of WPF or Silverlight, which never saw the light of day.
You may get banned for using Naticord, however it is an extremely low chance, and it most likely won't happen. Naticord gets frequent updates to prevent this from happening.
